FX-CCVIG-001.says: The settings as they start: amount 100, angle of view 90, about the middle, pin highlights 0. Each pixel's linear light is multiplied by the cos^4 falloff: the bottom right pixel keeps 0.289 of it, the middle four keep 0.989; nothing is lightened, and the empty corner stays empty.

FX-CCVIG-002.says: Amount 50: the square root of FX-CCVIG-001's gain at every pixel, the bottom right keeping 0.538.

FX-CCVIG-004.says: Amount -100: the edges lightened by the inverse of FX-CCVIG-001's gain, every channel held at 1: the skin near the corners turns white, the middle barely changes.

FX-CCVIG-005.says: Amount -50: lightened by the inverse square root, less than FX-CCVIG-004.

FX-CCVIG-006.says: Angle of view 0: no falloff at all: the drawing, untouched.

FX-CCVIG-007.says: Angle of view 150: a wide lens, a much stronger falloff, the bottom right keeping 0.0059 of its light.

FX-CCVIG-008.says: Angle of view 30: a long lens, a gentle falloff, the bottom right keeping 0.887.

FX-CCVIG-009.says: Centre 0, 0, the top left corner: the falloff about that corner, so the top left pixel is all but untouched and the bottom right darkest of all.

FX-CCVIG-010.says: Pin highlights 100: each pixel keeps more of itself the brighter it is: the skin (luma 0.86) loses only about a seventh of what FX-CCVIG-001 takes from it, the dark line along row 7 nearly all of it.

FX-CCVIG-011.says: Pin highlights 50: half way between FX-CCVIG-001's gain and FX-CCVIG-010's at every pixel.

FX-CCVIG-012.says: Amount -100, pin highlights 100: the lightening held back on bright pixels as the darkening is.

FX-CCVIG-013.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-CCVIG-002 and frame 4 FX-CCVIG-001.

FX-CCVIG-014.says: Amount eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-CCVIG-001; frame 0 is the drawing.

FX-CCVIG-015.says: Centre keyed from 50, 50 at frame 0 to 0, 0 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-CCVIG-001, frame 2 is about 25, 25 and frame 4 is FX-CCVIG-009.

FX-CCVIG-016.says: Angle of view keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 150 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 4 FX-CCVIG-007.

FX-CCVIG-017.says: FX-CCVIG-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the vignette moves with the drawing.

FX-CCVIG-018.says: A directional blur, direction 90 and length 4, then CC Vignette as it starts: the blur grew the layer two pixels on every side, and the falloff is still the drawing's own, about its own middle.

FX-CCVIG-019.says: Amount 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CCVIG-020.says: Amount -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CCVIG-021.says: Angle of view 180, above 179. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CCVIG-022.says: Angle of view -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CCVIG-023.says: Pin highlights 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CCVIG-024.says: Centre 50, -1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CCVIG-025.says: Pin highlights keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
